examples.summary: Both neighbours present. Hover either side and the chevron travels outward.

examples.name: Ends
examples.summary: The first and last pages of a series. The one remaining link stays anchored to its own edge — an absent side leaves a placeholder rather than collapsing, so a lone "Next" never drifts into the middle of the row. Each is given its own `aria-label` here because two nav landmarks may not share an accessible name; a real page carries one pagination and takes the default.
